title: rosa pendulina var. lagenaria
intro: Rosa pendulina var. lagenaria, commonly known as the alpine rose or hanging rose, is a plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae) known for its fragrant flowers and edible hips. The health benefits of Rosa pendulina var. lagenaria include its potential to support digestive health, boost the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Rosa pendulina var. lagenaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and organic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
